list.definition:
SELECT
  d.equipmentno AS "__value",
  COALESCE(NULLIF(d.equipmentdesc, ''), '[' || d.equipmentno || ']') AS "__text"
FROM eam_devices d
WHERE d.equipmentno IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY "__text";

title: AV: Device Details

targets.rawSql:
WITH RECURSIVE
device_positions AS (SELECT DISTINCT d.position::varchar AS position FROM eam_devices d WHERE d.position IS NOT NULL),
climb AS (
  SELECT dp.position AS start_pos,p.equipmentno::varchar AS cur_pos,
    p.parentasset::varchar AS parent_pos,0 AS depth,ARRAY[p.equipmentno::varchar]::varchar[] AS visited
  FROM device_positions dp JOIN eam_positions p ON p.equipmentno::varchar=dp.position
  UNION ALL
  SELECT c.start_pos,p.equipmentno::varchar,p.parentasset::varchar,c.depth+1,
    (c.visited||p.equipmentno::varchar)::varchar[]
  FROM climb c JOIN eam_positions p ON p.equipmentno::varchar=c.parent_pos
  WHERE c.parent_pos IS NOT NULL AND c.depth<100 AND NOT p.equipmentno::varchar=ANY(c.visited)
),
pos_to_room AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON(c.start_pos) c.start_pos,c.cur_pos AS room_no,c.depth
  FROM climb c JOIN eam_positions rp ON rp.equipmentno::varchar=c.cur_pos
  ORDER BY c.start_pos,c.depth DESC,c.cur_pos
),
listed AS (
  SELECT CONCAT(parts.p1,'/',parts.p2,'-',parts.p3) AS ConferenceRoomNoFmt,d.equipmentno AS EquipmentNo
  FROM eam_devices d
  JOIN pos_to_room pr ON pr.start_pos=d.position::varchar
  JOIN eam_positions room ON room.equipmentno::varchar=pr.room_no
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL(
    SELECT split_part(split_part(room.equipmentno::varchar,'-',2),'.',1) AS p1,
           split_part(split_part(room.equipmentno::varchar,'-',2),'.',2) AS p2,
           split_part(split_part(room.equipmentno::varchar,'-',2),'.',3) AS p3
  ) AS parts
)
SELECT ConferenceRoomNoFmt FROM listed WHERE EquipmentNo IN (${device:sqlstring}) LIMIT 1
SELECT eqclass FROM eam_devices WHERE equipmentno = ${device:sqlstring}
SELECT manufacturer FROM eam_devices WHERE equipmentno = ${device:sqlstring}
SELECT model FROM eam_devices WHERE equipmentno = ${device:sqlstring}
SELECT TO_CHAR(commissiondate,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS commissiondate FROM eam_devices WHERE equipmentno = ${device:sqlstring}
SELECT equipmentno FROM eam_devices WHERE equipmentno = ${device:sqlstring}
SELECT serialnumber FROM eam_devices WHERE equipmentno = ${device:sqlstring}
SELECT position FROM eam_devices WHERE equipmentno = ${device:sqlstring}
SELECT assetstatus_display FROM eam_devices WHERE equipmentno = ${device:sqlstring}
SELECT hostname FROM landb_ipaddresses WHERE equipmentno = ${device:sqlstring} LIMIT 1
SELECT category FROM eam_devices WHERE equipmentno = ${device:sqlstring}
SELECT power_status AS "Power Status" FROM avtools_projector_monitoring WHERE equipment_no = '$device'
SELECT firmware AS "Firmware" FROM avtools_projector_monitoring WHERE equipment_no = '$device'
SELECT sysdescr AS "System Description" FROM avtools_device_sysdescr_monitoring WHERE equipment_no = '$device'
SELECT sysdescr AS "System Description" FROM avtools_device_sysdescr_monitoring WHERE equipment_no = '$device'
